name: Ulugh Beg
contribution: A Timurid sultan, as well as an astronomer and mathematician.
legacy: During his rule the Timurid Empire achieved the cultural peak of the Timurid Renaissance through his attention and patronage.

checks.lead: Mīrzā Muhammad Tarāghāy bin Shāhrukh (Chagatay: میرزا محمد تراغای بن شاهرخ; Persian: میرزا محمد طارق بن شاهرخ), better known as Ulugh Beg (Persian: الغ‌بیگ; 22 March 1394 – 27 October 1449), was a Timurid sultan, as well as an astronomer and mathematician.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
